# RegistryData

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Registry value data: recorded truncated, hashed, or both, never in full
beyond the preview limit.

Appears at: `/registry/new`, `/registry/old`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `preview` | string | no |  | 1 to 1024 characters | 1.1.0 | The data as text: strings as they are, numbers in decimal, a list of strings joined with line feeds, anything else as lowercase hex. At most 1024 characters. |
| `sha256` | string | no |  | matches `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` | 1.1.0 | SHA-256 of the data's raw bytes. |
| `size` | integer | no |  | at least 0; format `uint32` | 1.1.0 | The size of the data in bytes. |
| `truncated` | constant | no |  | always `true` | 1.1.0 | The preview is shorter than the data. Only with a `preview`. |
| `value_type` | [`RegistryValueType`](types.md#registryvaluetype) | no |  |  | 1.1.0 | The value type. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
